# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 7 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 7:4 — set in bliss vs. live in happiness

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "set in bliss" | Literal constitutus in delicias |
| LOGOS | "established in paradise / live in happiness" | More natural English |
| PNEUMA | "settled in paradise... live in happiness" | Idiomatic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS 'live in happiness' flows naturally and captures delicias (delight, luxury). 'Bliss' (EMET) is accurate but slightly archaic. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
